subject: Jumpstart MAP proposal and slide skeleton
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@ellipsishealth.com>, Ellipsis Health Procurement <procurement@ellipsishealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Jumpstart MAP proposal and slide skeleton

Hi Sarah / procurement team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, I attached a concise MAP starter doc and a very lightweight slide skeleton you can use for internal stakeholders. The goal here is to align on a 45–60 day evaluation that demonstrates latency/cost at your typical workloads and validates integration with your data ingestion path.

Quick notes on the artifacts attached:
- Jumpstart-MAP-template.gdoc: 30/60/90 milestones, owner table, success criteria, and a short list of required infra items (VPC, test dataset, expected concurrency).
- MAP-slide-skeleton.pptx: single-slide summary for execs plus a technical appendix slide.

Would you be open to a short workshop next week (30–45m) to walk the MAP with your technical and procurement leads and lock dates? If yes, I can propose 3 slots.

Also flagging a couple of known items we expect to see on your side: SOC2 evidence request, data retention window, and model pinning for compliance. I attached the Ellipsis security questionnaire you sent and started an 'answers' column in the doc.

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcJumpstartMAP (view/comment)

Cheers,

Jasmine Liu
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Jumpstart-MAP-template.gdoc (Google Doc stub), MAP-slide-skeleton.pptx (slide deck stub), Ellipsis-security-questions.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@ellipsishealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ellipsis Health Procurement <procurement@ellipsishealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Jumpstart MAP proposal and slide skeleton

Thanks, Jasmine — this looks good and clear. Appreciate the structured approach. A few quick items from our side:

1) Procurement wants a short one-pager on commercial options (hosted vs. dedicated) and any committed throughput SLAs we should expect during the pilot.
2) Our security team wants the SOC2 section filled out and a note on where logs are retained for 90/180-day windows.
3) Can we shift the pilot to start the week of Sept 7? That gives our infra team time to carve out the test VPC.

Yes to a 45-minute workshop — propose Wed, Aug 19th 11:00–11:45am PT or Thu, Aug 20th 9:00–9:45am PT. Which works for you?

One more thing — we run a mix of short clinical free-text queries and batch batch-embedding jobs; the MAP template's performance targets look reasonable, but can you add a note on per-token cost sensitivity if we move to higher concurrency?

Best,
Sarah
Principal Product Manager | Ellipsis Health
sarah.cole@ellipsishealth.com

Looping in a couple of quick answers so we can move the doc forward before the workshop:

- Commercials: I'll draft a one-pager that outlines hosted vs dedicated pricing bands and estimated committed throughput. I will include a short table showing expected unit cost at 1k, 5k, and 20k tokens/sec sustained for the pilot window.
- SOC2 / logs: Irene, can you confirm retention windows we can commit to for pilot? I believe our hosted plan supports 90-day log retention by default; 180-day is available as an add-on.
- Workshop: Wed 8/19 11:00–11:45 PT works for me, will hold that. Jasmine — can you send calendar invite when confirmed?

Ben
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

To: Sarah Cole <sarah.cole@ellipsishealth.com>, Ellipsis Health Procurement <procurement@ellipsishealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Jumpstart MAP proposal and slide skeleton — next steps and updated doc

Sarah / team — thanks for the quick replies and for locking a workshop slot. Per Ben and Irene's notes I made three small updates to the MAP starter doc (version v1.1):

1) Commercial one-pager added to the Appendix (section 4). High-level hosted vs dedicated comparison and a sample cost table for the pilot throughput bands you asked for.
2) SOC2 answers: I filled the SOC2 column with the hosted defaults and flagged items where we need to confirm add-on retention (180-day) and KMS/HSM integration for production. See the highlighted rows.
3) Performance sensitivity note: added a short paragraph under Success Criteria describing per-token cost impacts at higher concurrency and recommended mitigation (quantization profile + prefix caching).

Workshop is confirmed: Wed, Aug 19 11:00–11:45am PT — invite sent. Please review the v1.1 doc ahead of the workshop and add any stakeholder names to the Owner table so we can assign tasks during the session.

Links: MAP v1.1 https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcJumpstartMAP (comment mode)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4582

Next steps (short):
- Sarah: confirm pilot start week (Sept 7) and share infra contact for VPC setup.
- Procurement: review the commercial one-pager and flag any procurement gating items.
- Ben/Irene: finalise the one-pager and SOC2 retention confirmation before the workshop.

Thanks — looking forward to the workshop.

Jasmine Liu
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: Jumpstart-MAP-template.gdoc (updated to v1.1), MAP-slide-skeleton.pptx (small edits), Ellipsis-security-questions.pdf (answered columns)
